material_definitions: The study compares pure garnet-type Li-stuffed lanthanum zirconate (LLZTO) with a PEO/LiTFSI-LLZTO composite electrolyte.
The composite electrolyte PEO/LiTFSI-LLZTO was formed via a simple solvent-casting method.
The study compares pure garnet-type Li-stuffed lanthanum zirconate (LLZTO) with a PEO/LiTFSI-LLZTO composite electrolyte.
The composite electrolyte PEO/LiTFSI-LLZTO was formed via a simple solvent-casting method.

*Figure 6: a) Measured speeds of sound for Li6PS5X using the sound-response echo method (PE) and resonant ultrasound spectroscopy (RUS). With increasing polarizability of the halide anion, the speed of sound decreases and then slightly increases for Li6PS5I. b) With decreasing lattice stiffness (i.e. decreasing speed of sound) the activation energy and the pre-factor σ0 decrease. The increase in the iodine containing samples can be attributed to the lack of anion-disorder. The concurrent decrease of E*<sup>A</sup> *and σ*0 *leads to an overall decrease of the (c) conductivity with increasing softness of the anion* [Series: EA] [X-Axis: X-axis]
